with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Performance, Learning and Accountability</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.</li> <li>Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.</li> <li>Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills &amp; Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.</li> <li>Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.</li> <li>Fluency in English fonio.ai is a market leader in AI agents for SMBs. We started with phone agents and now also cover WhatsApp, web chat, email and a full AI phone system. We’re growing fast across Europe, the UK, the US and Brazil.

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months, then went from $10M to $20M in about 8 weeks. Today we serve 10,000+ customers.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.
Join one of the fastest-growing companies! 🚀

The role

You'll own Content Marketing for the French-speaking market and shape how thousands of businesses discover, understand and trust fonio.

From performance ads and landing pages to organic content and product messaging, you'll help define our voice across every stage of the customer journey.

What you'll do

  • Own website and landing page copy for the French-speaking market

  • Write high-performing copy for Meta, Google, LinkedIn and other paid channels

  • Script ad creatives for YouTube and Paid Social

  • Create and execute organic content strategies across social platforms

  • Collaborate with creators, customers and influencers to produce authentic content

  • Improve messaging through user research, A/B testing and performance insights

  • Help shape product positioning and go-to-market messaging

What you bring

  • 4+ years of experience in Content Marketing, Copywriting or Growth Marketing

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or another fast-growing software environment

  • Outstanding writing skills in French

  • Strong understanding of performance marketing and conversion-focused copy

  • Analytical mindset and a passion for experimentation

  • Native French and fluent English

What we offer

  • €65,000–100,000 salary depending on experience

  • Equity

  • Hardware of your choice

  • Regular team offsites

  • Paid relocation to Vienna for approximately two months

  • Lunch, dinner, snacks and drinks at our Vienna office

Hiring process

  • 15 min intro call

  • 30 min skill interview

  • 20 min culture call

How we hire?
We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.
Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet 🚀

title: Pullup Entertainment - Cdi - Responsable Comptable Generale (H/F/Nb)
description: Chez PulluP Entertainment, nous avons pour but d’offrir aux joueurs du monde entier des expériences uniques. Notre ligne éditoriale se démarque grâce à des concepts innovants, des gameplays alternatifs et des univers originaux qui transcendent les frontières du jeu vidéo. Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience et de succès, nous mettons notre passion et notre créativité au service du jeu et d’histoires inoubliables. Pour le plaisir de tous . Véritable bras droit du Directeur comptable, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec lui sur tout le périmètre, maison mère comme filiales. Vous aurez la responsabilité de deux comptables généraux ayant chacun un périmètre défini et un comptable client.  Vos principales missions seront : 1- Gestion quotidienne de la tenue de la comptabilité et le bon suivi des obligations : Supervision de la comptabilité clients (suivi des comptes clients et des relances) et générale (provisions, paie, fiscalités, etc.) Echanges continus et réguliers avec la comptabilité fournisseur Assurer le bon suivi de l’établissement des déclarations fiscales et des comptes annuels Assurer le bon suivi du juridique annuel Assurer la gestion des déclarations fiscales de l'entreprise (TVA, IS et autres obligations fiscales). 2- Etablissement des clôtures périodiques (dont la semestrielle et l’annuelle sont publiées) :  Pour les sociétés dont la tenue comptable est internalisée : établissement de clôture complète en collaboration avec les équipes comptables internes Pour les sociétés françaises dont la tenue est externalisée et les sociétés étrangères : assurer le suivi, la communication et la revue des remontées des informations avec la comptable générale en charge Etablissement et suivi des calendriers de clôtures en collaboration avec le contrôle de gestion Veiller au respect des exigences réglementaires et fiscales 3- Audit et Comptes consolidés : Vous serez le.a garant.e de la bonne réciprocité des comptes inter-compagnies  Vous serez l’interlocuteur.trice principal.e auprès de la société qui effectue les comptes consolidés du Groupe.  Point de contact pour les auditeurs autant sur les comptes sociaux que sur les comptes consolidés  Vous aurez un rôle essentiel dans l’établissement des rapports financiers semestriels et annuels qui sont publiés 4- Management : Vous encadrerez une équipe de trois personnes en définissant les priorités et les objectifs de l’équipe en accord vos managers Vous participerez à la montée en compétence des collaborateurs et à la définition de leur plan de formation Vous serez un soutien de l’équipe pour les tâches quotidiennes   5- Projets Transverses Mise en place de process généralisés et homogénéisés des filiales dont la tenue est internalisée en collaboration avec la Direction financière Déploiement et optimisation des process d'automatisation comptable Participer aux projets d'amélioration des processus et des systèmes financiers   Ce que l'on attend de vous :  Véritable référent(e) comptable, vous êtes capable de garantir la fiabilité des comptes tout en accompagnant les évolutions d'une organisation en croissance. Diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Comptabilité, Finance ou Audit (DSCG, Master CCA ou équivalent), vous disposez d'une solide expertise technique. Vous justifiez d 'au moins 5 années d'expérience en cabinet d'audit ou d'expertise comptable OU d'au moins 7 années d'expérience en comptabilité générale au sein d'un environnement international. Vous avez déjà accompagné des projets structurants (croissance externe, intégration de sociétés, évolution des processus ou des outils financiers) et en maîtrisez les impacts comptables, fiscaux et organisationnels. Vous possédez une expérience réussie en management et savez fédérer, développer et faire monter en compétence vos équipes. Vous maîtrisez les normes comptables françaises (French GAAP), ainsi que les réglementations fiscales et sociales françaises. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel, et appréciez l'amélioration continue des processus. Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement international et êtes capable d'échanger quotidiennement en anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Une connaissance de SAP ByDesign constitue un atout apprécié. Ce que l'on dit de vous : Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) capable d'accompagner le business avec pragmatisme et leadership. Vous combinez autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités. Vous savez prendre du recul, prioriser et structurer votre activité dans un environnement en constante évolution. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à embarquer les équipes et à créer des relations de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs. Pédagogue, vous savez rendre accessibles des sujets comptables, fiscaux ou juridiques complexes auprès d'équipes non spécialistes. title: Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution - Manager
description: Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises. Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions. En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International". L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution est spécialisée en évaluation de préjudice et accompagnement sur le volet financier de précontentieux et contentieux en tant qu’expert de partie dans le cadre de procédures amiables, judiciaires, ou arbitrales, mais également en tant que tiers expert. L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution de Eight Advisory, acteur reconnu sur son marché et en fort développement, recherche un futur manager. En tant que consultant manager, vous aurez l’opportunité d’intervenir sur des dossiers pluridisciplinaires afin de développer vos expertises et des compétences transverses sur nos métiers du conseil. Au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine, en forte croissance, vous interviendrez sur des missions d’ : · Evaluation de préjudice et de support aux contentieux à forts enjeux pour nos clients (rupture de relations contractuelles, sinistres industriels, litiges post-acquisition, clauses d’ajustement de prix, responsabilité contractuelle, actions en concurrence déloyale et en contrefaçon, etc.). · Expertise financière dans le cadre de revue de grands projets industriels (analyse de l’origine de dérapage et appréciation des risques associés) et d’accompagnement de sociétés dans le cadre de leur changement stratégique (préparation de business plan, aide à la décision dans le cadre de changement structurel). · Investigation financière liée à des problématiques de détournement d’actifs, de manipulation d’états financiers, d’infraction réglementaire etc. · Analyses de gestion en lien avec une mise en responsabilité du dirigeant en cas de défaillance d’entreprise (analyse de l’origine des difficultés, analyse des flux comptables et financiers, détermination de la date de cessation des paiements, etc.). · Ingénierie financière liée à des enjeux haut de bilan et des enjeux opérationnels. Au quotidien, sous la direction des associés du département, vous serez responsable des travaux suivants : · Conception et réalisation des analyses financières et comptables, · Rédaction des projets de livrable, · Animation de la relation avec les différents intervenants présents sur les missions (clients et avocats), · Encadrement et formation d’une équipe de seniors et d'analystes, · Gestion des aspects administratifs des dossiers (organisation de la mission, facturation, suivi des heures). Vos travaux seront adaptés aux besoins de nos clients et auront pour objectif de créer de la valeur dans des situations complexes de précontentieux ou de contentieux. Vous aurez l’occasion : · De bénéficier d’une diversité d’approches (problématiques financières, juridiques, stratégiques et opérationnelles) ; · D’être exposé aux clients et aux avocats, et notamment de participer aux réunions de présentation de nos analyses et d’échanges avec les opérationnels ; · De faire un travail à haute valeur ajoutée pour nos clients. Vous participerez également à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités et au développement de notre activité (organisation d’évènements, rédaction d’article etc.), et aurez l’opportunité de vous investir sur des projets transverses au sein du cabinet (formation, recrutement, RSE, parrainage des juniors etc.). Diplômé(e) d’une grande école de commerce ou d'un Master CCA, vous justifiez d’une expérience de 5 à 7 ans en cabinet d’audit et vous vous êtes spécialisé(e) en évaluation de préjudice financier. Vous êtes doté (e) de solides bases comptables, de qualités analytiques et rédactionnelles avérées, vous maitrisez l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit et idéalement l’espagnol. Curieux(se), persévérant(e), polyvalent(e), disponible et ambitieux(se), vous savez encadrer des équipes, prendre des initiatives et avez le sens du service client. raw.description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. 

The Role:

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite.

We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. 

We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. 

Missions

  • Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after.
  • Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration.
  • Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change.
  • Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine".
  • Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention.
  • Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive.
  • Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification.
  • Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English.

Experience & Seniority:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products
  • Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice:

  • Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability
  • A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate
  • Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality:

  • Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code
  • Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have
  • Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role):

  • Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed
  • Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop
  • Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration:

  • Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead
  • Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup
  • Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education:

  • Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

  • It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.
  • It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.
  • It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node.js / TypeScript
  • Frontend: Vue.js 3
  • Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;
  • Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
  • Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)

  • Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification
  • Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

About the role

As Product Marketing Manager, you shape how the market understands our portfolio: positioning, differentiation and outside-in stories that turn complex legal tech into value buyers recognise, and that drive pipeline and revenue.

Scope

You'll join a small Product Marketing team within the global Marketing department. Your focus is the market narrative and making sure GTM teams use it. Product training, documentation and demo environments sit with our Enablement teams. Success means clarity in the market, consistent positioning, and GTM teams who tell our story well.

Core responsibilities

Foundational strategy

  • Develop deep market and competitive insight.
  • Update and evolve ICPs, personas and use cases.
  • Inform product and GTM direction based on market opportunity and customer reality.

Positioning and messaging

  • Apply positioning, differentiation and value propositions across all content and assets, internal and external.
  • Translate product capabilities into compelling, customer-centric narratives.
  • Shape the content and messaging frameworks that guide all customer-facing communication.

Operational impact

  • Activate positioning across the GTM organization through launch alignment, messaging briefings and strategic field engagement.
  • Partner with Sales Enablement to embed messaging frameworks in the field.
  • Drive coherence across website, campaigns, launches and proof points.
  • Refine positioning using win/loss insights and market feedback.
  • Become a product expert: hold regular syncs with Product Managers on releases and roadmap, and turn each release into clear customer value.

AI and new ways of working

  • Design, test and run AI-assisted PMM workflows, for example call and win/loss analysis, competitive monitoring and content review.
  • Document what works so the whole Marketing team can reuse it.
  • Bring new ideas on how we work, and test them quickly.

Who you work with

  • Reports to: Senior Product Marketing Manager
  • Daily collaboration: Global Marketing team (10 people), Product Enablement, Sales Enablement, Customer Success Enablement
  • Key stakeholders: Product, Sales, Customer Success

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally in enterprise or complex software.
  • A proven track record shaping positioning, messaging and GTM strategy, not just executing it.
  • Cross-functional experience with Product, Sales and Customer Success teams.
  • Remote-first: you've built alignment across time zones without a shared office.
  • An analytical mindset: data is the foundation of most of our decisions.
  • Curious and hands-on with AI: you use it every day, like a colleague. We don't need an AI expert, but someone who enjoys testing new tools and building better ways of working with them.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

What really sets you apart

Strategic thinker, decisive operator: you know when to challenge and when to ship.
Market-obsessed: you anticipate competitor moves and spot positioning gaps.
Exceptional storyteller: you simplify complexity without diluting substance.
Business-minded: you link your work to pipeline, win rates and deal velocity.
Builder with AI: you've already set up a new process, agent or workflow with AI and can show what changed.
Impact over output: you measure influence, not volume.
Strong opinions, loosely held: you defend your view with evidence and adjust when the market proves otherwise.
Problem solver with energy: you move problems forward at pace, even when they sit outside your job description.
Team player with range: you work easily with Product, Sales and CS, and adapt to what the team needs this week.
Out-of-the-box thinker: you question how things are done, propose new ways and test them.

Recruitment process

1.Phone screening with Talent Acquisition
2.First interview with our Senior Product Marketing Manager
3.Case study
4.Team and stakeholder interviews, including our Global Head of Marketing
5.Final interview with our CEO or another key stakeholder

title: Applied AI Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in France. As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems. You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance. Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions. You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results. You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes. Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions. As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy. Accountabilities In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include: Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops. Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability. Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes. Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices. Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment. Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows. Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention. Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities. Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively. Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes. Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems. Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows. Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function. Requirements The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected: Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment. Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments. Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability. Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops. Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems. Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering. Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs. Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges. Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment. High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations. Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English. Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Annual salary ranging from €100,000 to €150,000. Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely within Europe or the United Kingdom. Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions. Technical Autonomy: Shape engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and the foundations of the organization's agentic AI infrastructure. Cutting-Edge Technology: Work extensively with advanced LLMs, autonomous agents, multi-agent architectures, and AI-powered software development workflows. Meaningful Impact: Build production systems that address real operational challenges and deliver measurable business value. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product and operational teams to identify opportunities and develop practical automation solutions. description: Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning   Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence. In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running. At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. What you'll do Headhunt top profiles (Sales / Marketing / Support functions), by sourcing and reaching out to great talents after having identified the needs of team leaders and hiring managers. Assess applications, by managing candidates’ screening and by conducting pre-qualification interviews for the positions that will have been assigned to you. Provide an excellent candidate experience and apply competency-based assessment methodology. Proactively engage and manage internal stakeholders, by coaching and sharing good practices with our hiring managers. Track and report talent acquisition metrics to identify best practices and pain points. Who you are You have experience in Talent Acquisition in a fast-growing environment and/or experience in Go-to-market/commercial/business profile hiring. Mixed agency/search and internal TA experience. Headhunting experience honed through best-in-class Sales-led organisations. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges and being hands-on. You have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, you are able to build strong relationships with candidates and employees. You like productivity tools and you know how to manage and prioritize your tasks in a structured way. You are curious, you like learning and working in autonomy. You are pragmatic and know how to solve problems quickly. You are analytical and rigorous. You have outstanding writing and verbal communication skills in English. How we work Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet. Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community. Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission. Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment. - De ne pas se cantonner à une seule étape du cycle de vente 
- De travailler avec et pour des consultants 
- De pouvoir poursuivre par la suite avec un poste en CDI 
- D’une entreprise qui valorise son capital humain 
 
MARGO, c’est aussi

- Une politique de formation illimitée

- 100% du pass Navigo remboursé

title: System Architect
description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness. As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers. Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production. This role is for you if… you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down. This role isn’t for you if… you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start. Key Responsibilities Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance. Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design. Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams. Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system. Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve. Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production. Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system. Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations. Qualifications MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems. Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead. Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product. Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics. Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact. Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics. Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products. Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements. The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland. Nice to Have Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers. Knowledge of data center power architectures. Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering. Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization. Benefits Equity + competitive salary. Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition. Hybrid work with flexible working times. title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
description: You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants. Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity. WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do: Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations. Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations. Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed. Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor. Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better. Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck. You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it You're open to travel 30-50% of the time This is how we'll set you up in your first six months: Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account. Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team. Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion. Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like: Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field Bonus: Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments Fluency in German, French, or another European language WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast. Additionally, we offer: Performance-based career & growth paths On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation Flexible parental leave Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.   • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

  • A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

  • Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

  • Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

As an Engineering Manager at Sonar, you will lead a squad of 8 developers to build, automate and operate software used by millions of Sonar customers worldwide. You will own the professional growth and development of your team, enabling them to build well-crafted software for our products, and promoting a high-performance engineering culture. 

You will improve our products by leading the elaboration of the squad's annual and quarterly objectives in close collaboration with the AI team while contributing to and overseeing technical architecture and engineering direction. 

You will help to bring consistency across Sonar’s engineering organization by collaborating closely with your engineering manager peers to foster and share engineering best practices.


What you will do

  • Lead and manage a team of Engineers, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help individuals grow in autonomy and contribute to the team's success.

  • Hold yourself and your team accountable to a high engineering standard.

  • Foster a safe culture of feedback, continuous improvement, and collaboration, encouraging team members to share their ideas and concerns openly.

  • Align feedback with other teams to ensure things operate smoothly between teams.

  • Ensure the squad defines clear objectives that are aligned with team, department, and company goals.

  • Be accountable for tracking sprint progress.

  • Be accountable that processes and ceremonies align with company expectations to deliver the best product successfully.

  • Ensure that the right level of collaboration happens with the squad stakeholders (Product Managers, developer squads, Marketing, Management, etc.).

    • Experience and qualifications

  • 8+ years of software development or equivalent experience in the software development domain, with a strong understanding of software testing. 

  • Having a developer mindset: experience with coding lifecycle, ability to produce secure code, to do code reviews, and to jump into an unknown codebase, language, and framework.

  • Advanced knowledge of the Java ecosystem

  • Good knowledge of at least one programming language along with its development environment to understand end-user's context and expectations.

  • Experience with Agile methodologies.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and resources effectively.

  • Capability to make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect knowledge.

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
description: Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln. Ihre Verantwortung Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher. Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle. Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg. Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein. Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte. Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern. Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion. Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil. Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen. Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien. Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung. Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Die Position verlangt Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft ebenso wie einen verlässlichen Blick auf das Ganze. Interessiert? Vertraulicher Erstkontakt Sie möchten mehr erfahren? description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">FEQ228R125</p> <p>As a Senior Specialist Solutions Architect (Sr. SSA) for AI/ML, you will be the go-to technical expert for Databricks' AI platform across our customers. You will help them move from AI experiments to <strong>governed, cost-efficient agents and ML systems running on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform</strong>.</p> <p>You will work with Account Executives and Solutions Architects to win strategic opportunities. You will design architectures for advanced agent and ML use cases and lead hands-on proofs of concept and MVPs. You will act as a trusted advisor to customer technical leaders on AI strategy, governance and economics. You will also shape our AI go-to-market in the region, enable the wider field team, and feed what you learn from customers back to Product and Engineering.</p> <p>This role reports to the Manager, Specialist Solutions Architects – Switzerland, Austria &amp; Eastern Europe.</p> <h3><strong>The impact you will have</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Win the technical decision for AI on Databricks.</strong> Lead discovery, architecture design, demos, proofs of concept and MVPs for agent, GenAI and ML use cases in competitive evaluations.</li> <li><strong>Design production-grade agent systems.</strong> Architect agents and multi-agent applications using Agent Bricks, Databricks Apps, MCP tools, Lakebase, AI Search and the Foundation Model APIs. Govern assets under Unity Catalog</li> <li><strong>Make agent quality measurable.</strong> Help customers build evaluation and observability into everything they ship, using MLflow tracing, domain-specific LLM judges, labelled evaluation datasets, release gates and production monitoring.</li> <li><strong>Govern AI at enterprise scale.</strong> Position the AI Gateway as the central control point for model access, guardrails, PII protection, usage tracking and rate limiting.</li> <li><strong>Scale your expertise.</strong> Enable SAs and partners with workshops, reusable assets and reference architectures.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Influence the product.</strong> Bring structured customer feedback and requirements specific to the market to Product Management and Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Be a visible voice.</strong> Represent Databricks at customer executive briefings, meetups, conferences and in written content.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we look for</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering or data science, including customer-facing technical work (pre-sales, consulting or technical leadership).</li> <li><strong>A track record of shipping LLM and agent systems to production</strong>, not just prototypes, including evaluation, monitoring and cost management.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of agent architecture: tool use and function calling, MCP, agent memory and state, orchestrating multiple agents, and retrieval and context design.</li> <li>Strong practical experience <strong>evaluating GenAI systems</strong>: tracing, LLM-as-a-judge, building evaluation datasets, regression testing and observability in production.</li> <li>Hands-on with at least one modern agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, DSPy). You should be framework-agnostic in how you design.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the foundation-model landscape (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models) and the trade-offs between quality, latency, cost and data residency.</li> <li>Strong grounding in classical ML and MLOps: model development, deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management at scale.</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills in Python and SQL. You use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) daily and can build a working demo application quickly.</li> <li>Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data platforms.</li> <li>Proven ability to influence technical leaders up to CTO/CDO level and to explain complex AI topics in business terms.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Proven ability to communicate and teach complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. raw.title: Technology Marketing Manager
raw.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market.

You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.

Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows, helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.

This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.

What you will do

Technology & Product Narrative

  • Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

  • Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

  • Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

  • Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

Messaging & Positioning Framework

  • Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

  • Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

  • Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

  • Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

Content Strategy & Creation

  • Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

  • Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

  • Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration)

  • Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

  • Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

  • Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

  • Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

Who you are

Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

  • You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

  • Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

  • Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

  • Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

  • Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

  • Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Ways of working

  • Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

  • Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

  • Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

  • Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

  • Energized by a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. You adapt quickly, stay ahead of change, and are willing to challenge your own choices and iterate on them.

  • Genuine passion for technology, engineering, innovation, and AI. You naturally follow what’s happening in the field, enjoy exploring how new technologies change the way products are designed, and have a strong appetite for learning and continuous improvement.

  • Proactive and eager to step in beyond the core scope when projects call for it, contributing to product-related communications such as events, press releases, website updates, or newsletters.

What you get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Expansion Associate (H/F) - 100%
description: Tu n'abandonnes pas au premier refus, ni au dixième. Tu traites une liste le vendredi après-midi avec le même soin que le lundi matin, et tu mènes à terme ce que tu as commencé, pour que rien ne reste en suspens et que rien ne vieillisse en silence dans un coin. Tu n'as besoin de personne derrière ton épaule pour tenir ton niveau d'exigence. Et quand un cas ne rentre pas dans le processus, tu le signales au lieu de bricoler une solution. Si tu te reconnais dans ces lignes, tu es au bon endroit. En tant qu' Expansion Associate , tu es le chasseur ou la chasseuse d'appartements de Room Estate en Suisse romande , avec un accent sur Genève. Tu es responsable de l'acquisition d'appartements de A à Z : tu passes le marché au crible, tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving, tu le visites sur place, tu postules en notre nom, tu relances et tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature du bail. C'est un rôle pour les personnes qui passent à l'action, et c'est précisément sa force : fréquence, ténacité et sens des responsabilités dans un processus clairement défini. Notre principe directeur : la croissance naît d'un tri des annonces à haute fréquence, d'une évaluation rigoureuse et de relances systématiques, pas de coups de chance. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec notre responsable de l'équipe Acquisition, qui tranche les cas d'appréciation, et ton travail se mesure à ce qui compte au final : les chambres acquises, les baux signés et la qualité de ce que tu ramènes. Tasks Tu passes les portails immobiliers au crible de manière systématique , chaque jour et avec un regard sûr pour ce qui convient. Tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving : plan, état, immeuble, et la question de savoir si la propriété est prête à jouer le jeu. Tu organises les visites et tu te rends sur place pour vérifier sur l'objet réel ce que promet l'annonce. Tu postules en notre nom et tu positionnes Room Estate comme le locataire que toute régie souhaite avoir. Tu relances jusqu'à ce qu'une décision soit prise. Aucun dossier ne s'enlise. Tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature et tu contrôles le bail à l'aide de notre liste de contrôle : points critiques, clauses manquantes et écarts par rapport à l'annonce. Tu tiens le suivi des dossiers à jour : chaque objet saisi, chaque statut traçable. Requirements Sens des responsabilités et autonomie. Tu fais avancer un processus de bout en bout à une fréquence élevée et à un rythme fiable, tu vas au bout de chaque suivi et tu ne laisses aucun dossier s'enliser. C'est le cœur de ce rôle. Maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, dans les échanges avec les régies et les propriétaires. Ténacité et sens de la négociation, le marché locatif genevois dit souvent non, et cela ne te déstabilise pas. Un œil pour les plans, tu vois d'emblée si le coliving fonctionne dans un appartement et combien de chambres sont réalistes. Rigueur dans le travail avec des listes de contrôle, tu vas au bout de chaque point plutôt que de faire les choses à peu près, et tu repères les écarts. Aucune connaissance spécialisée en droit du bail n'est requise. Permis de conduire catégorie B et disponibilité pour des visites régulières à Genève, dans la région lémanique et dans le reste de la Suisse romande. Anglais courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, notre langue de travail interne. BONUS Expérience dans le secteur immobilier suisse (formation en gérance immobilière, cours USPI, activité de courtage) Réseau existant auprès des régies et des propriétaires à Genève et dans la région lémanique Expérience dans l' univers du coliving ou des appartements meublés avec services Connaissances de base du droit du bail suisse Allemand Benefits Salaire fixe plus bonus progressif pour chaque chambre acquise, sans plafond : plus tu acquiers de chambres, plus tu gagnes par chambre. Bureau à Lausanne, avec la possibilité de télétravailler certains jours Équipement de ton choix (ordinateur portable, écran, accessoires) Des processus et des listes de contrôle documentés, et un·e responsable d'équipe à qui reviennent les exceptions, pour que tu puisses faire ta part avec précision au lieu d'improviser Un rôle qui t'appartient : tu ne fais pas partie d'une équipe d'acquisition, tu es l'acquisition en Suisse romande Une équipe internationale et solidaire, avec une vraie culture de l'apprentissage Budget de formation continue (cours, livres, conférences) Une vraie évolution : ton ambition détermine jusqu'où tu iras, tes résultats à quelle vitesse. Ton périmètre de responsabilité grandit avec les deux. Chez Room Estate, tu bénéficies de vraies responsabilités et d'un feedback direct, sans micromanagement ni langue de bois. On se tutoie, on se dit les choses, et nous sommes exigeants : tu as le droit de l'être tout autant avec nous. Des séminaires d'équipe, une fête d'été annuelle et une collaboration étroite avec des collègues de différents pays font partie de l'aventure et élargissent ton réseau personnel et professionnel. Mais l'essentiel est simple : nous voulons progresser chaque jour et nous cherchons des personnes qui le veulent aussi. Ici, tu assumes un rôle qui compte, dans un environnement international, et tu contribues activement à façonner l'avenir du coliving en Europe. Rejoins Room Estate et construis avec nous l'avenir du logement. 🚀 Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineering Manager
description: Bouw aan de software van morgen. Ontwikkel de engineers die het mogelijk maken. Dan komen we graag met je in contact.   Bij ons speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Software Engineering-organisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei, kwaliteit en prestaties van een team van circa 45 (embedded) softwareprofessionals en zorgt ervoor dat zij de juiste omgeving, richting en ondersteuning krijgen om complexe technologische uitdagingen succesvol aan te gaan.   Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Je creëert een omgeving waarin vakmanschap, kennisdeling, innovatie en continue verbetering centraal staan. Daarnaast volg je technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en stimuleer je de inzet van moderne technologieën om softwareontwikkeling slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.   Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 45 embedded software engineers en ondersteunt hen in hun professionele en persoonlijke groei. Je geeft richting aan AI-gedreven transformatie binnen het softwareteam én de bredere organisatie, en neemt je team en collega’s mee in nieuwe manieren van werken. Je stimuleert een cultuur van technische excellentie, eigenaarschap en samenwerking. Je zorgt voor de juiste balans tussen projectresultaten, de ontwikkeling van je team en langetermijndoelstellingen. Je werkt samen met architecten, technical leads en projectteams aan de verdere professionalisering van softwareontwikkeling binnen Benchmark. Je bewaakt de benodigde capaciteit, competenties en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling. Je speelt een actieve rol in het aantrekken, ontwikkelen en behouden van softwaretalent. Je versterkt de samenwerking met internationale engineeringteams binnen Benchmark. Je vertegenwoordigt Software Engineering binnen het Competence Management Team en levert een actieve bijdrage aan organisatiebrede besluitvorming. Je stimuleert het gebruik van moderne ontwikkelmethodieken en tooling om kwaliteit, productiviteit en innovatie te versterken. Je vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, werkwijzen en engineering excellence.   Samen met de managers van Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan een toekomstbestendige engineeringorganisatie. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om samenwerking tussen disciplines te versterken en technologische ontwikkelingen succesvol naar de praktijk te vertalen.   Waarom deze functie? Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van people leadership, technologie en strategische impact. Je krijgt de ruimte om onze softwareorganisatie verder vorm te geven, talent te ontwikkelen en invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop complexe high-tech producten worden ontworpen en ontwikkeld.
